about: The feeds the viewer at /reader/ offers. 'Open to browsers' sources send a CORS header, so a reader's browser can fetch them directly; each was checked on 22 October 2026. The closed ones send none: they are listed so a reader knows they exist and why the viewer cannot read them. Readers add their own feeds in their browser.
